The documentation for the `addItem` function is incomplete and potentially misleading. The parameter description states `item (string): the item to add`, but the function signature is `void addItem(list<string> &itemList, string item)`. The documentation fails to describe the first parameter, `itemList`, which is the list being modified. A comprehensive comment should explain both parameters, for example: "Adds an item to the end of the given list. Params: itemList (list<string>&): the list to modify. item (string): the item to add."

The color of a common crow is black.
